description:
Enter a realm of fantasy with The Black Lotus. Inspired by the legendary Black Lotus power card, this silicone masturbator merges the allure of the lotus flower with a touch of mystical power.

Its delicate petals open to reveal an inner sanctum of pleasure, with an inviting, textured interior and an ergonomic shape that's easy to hold.

Explore The Black Lotus in 3D

Spin it, slide the diameter ring to measure it at any point, compare it with a soda or Monster can, and tap the AR button on your phone to see it at real size in your room.

Why you'll love The Black Lotus

  • Intricate lotus-petal design
  • Textured interior
  • Ergonomic grip
  • Seamless and easy to clean
  • Handmade in Australia from skin-safe silicone – Australian Made Certified

Make it yours

List two colours and/or glitters (the colour charts are in the gallery). No colours listed? We'll choose a stunning combination for you. Made to order – ships in 2–5 business days in plain, unmarked packaging.

sections.title: Materials & Colours
sections.html:
The Black Lotus is handmade in Australia from high-grade, skin-safe, soft-touch silicone (density: ultra soft). All our silicone toys are Australian Made Certified.

Colours: list two colours and/or glitters when you order – see the colour charts in the gallery. The charts are a reference guide only: colours shift once mixed into silicone, and every pour is unique. If no colours are listed, we'll select a stunning combination for you.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.html: One size. Use with plenty of water-based lube, and clean after each session.
